sentences.text: Ismail Sk. & Ors vs Unknown on 7 October, 2024

Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
07.10.2024.
13.
Ct.No.6
as
 Crr 3668 of 2024

In the matter of : Ismail Sk. & Ors.
 ... Petitioners.
 Mr. Arnab Chatterjee,
 Mr. Anisur Rahaman.
 ...for the Petitioners.
 1.
Petitioners are the husband and in-laws of the opposite party no.2-wife.
They contend they have been subjected to a series of criminal prosecution at the behest of opposite party no.2-wife.
They pray for quashing of the impugned criminal proceeding.
2. I have considered the materials on record.

Prior to the institution of the impugned proceeding,
opposite party no.2- wife had instituted two criminal cases against the petitioners.
Opposite party no.2 is residing separately since 2020.
Possibility of malicious institution of the impugned criminal proceeding cannot be ruled out.
Petitioner has made out an arguable case in their favour.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon opposite party No.1/State through learned Public Prosecutor,
High Court, Calcutta and upon opposite party No.2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit of service be filed on the next date of hearing.
4. Let the matter appear under the heading 'Contested Application' four weeks after Puja vacation.
5. There shall be stay of operation of the impugned proceeding being Berhampore Women Police Station Charge Sheet No.130 of 2022 dated 31.10.2022 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 498A/494/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code arising out of Berhampore Women Police Station Case No.87 of 2022 dated 14.06.2022 corresponding to G. R. 2513 of 2022 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Berhampore, Murshidabad for a period of six weeks after Puja vacation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
